title: Return to the wilderness
summary: After Nephi and others came down into the wilderness to their father, he was filled with joy. Nephi’s mother, Sariah, was exceedingly glad; she had mourned because of them.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi and others came down into the wilderness to their father.
Their father was filled with joy.
Nephi’s mother, Sariah, was exceedingly glad.
Sariah had mourned because of them.

unspecified_visual_details: The identities and number of the others with Nephi.

narration.text: we had come down into the wilderness unto our father
he was filled with joy, and also my mother, Sariah, was exceedingly glad

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The first-person narrator is Nephi, as specified for this chapter. Sariah’s mourning happened before this moment; do not depict it as simultaneous with her gladness.

title: Sariah’s complaint recalled
summary: The narrator reports that Sariah supposed her sons had perished in the wilderness and complained against the narrator’s father, calling him a visionary man and saying her sons were no more and they were perishing in the wilderness.

Sariah said that he had led them forth from the land of their inheritance, and that her sons were no more and they were perishing in the wilderness.
The narrator says that this was the manner of language with which his mother complained against his father.

unspecified_visual_details: The appearance, expressions, and gestures of the people involved; the setting of the complaint.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a specific setting or present-tense action for the complaint.
